summary: This Form 8-K filed by HIVE Digital Technologies Ltd. reports two routine corporate events: (i) final TSX listing approval for its common shares, effective May 12, 2026, with delisting from TSX Venture Exchange; and (ii) a quarterly ATM Offering update disclosing issuance of 14,983,561 shares for $41.1M in gross proceeds during the quarter ended March 31, 2026. No special-situation transaction—acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or other—is present. The filing merely updates exchange listing and capital-raising activity. What to watch: continued ATM issuance pace and Nasdaq/TSX dual listing dynamics.
